A '''battle''' took place on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]] in [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], and was part of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Outer Rim Sieges/Legends|campaign]] to cripple the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] by taking out a Confederate base on Ryloth.
